chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在岸上/上岸(go / come / be on shore),与在船上 on board 相对。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors were glad to be on shore again.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们很高兴又回到了岸上。

chunks.head: take heart
chunks.note: take heart = 在困难/害怕之后重拾信心、打起精神。
chunks.ex_en: Take heart—things will get better soon.
chunks.ex_cn: 振作起来——情况很快会好转。

chunks.head: a great deal
chunks.note: a great deal (of …) = 很多(修饰不可数名词,或作副词'…得多')。
chunks.ex_en: She knows a great deal about birds.
chunks.ex_cn: 她对鸟类了解很多。

chunks.head: in the first place
chunks.note: in the first place = 列举理由时的'首先';也可指'一开始、本来'。
chunks.ex_en: In the first place, we don't have enough time.
chunks.ex_cn: 首先,我们时间不够。

chunks.head: out of one's wits
chunks.gloss: 吓得魂不附体;惊慌失措
chunks.note: (scared / frightened) out of one's wits = 吓得不知所措。
chunks.ex_en: The loud bang scared me out of my wits.
chunks.ex_cn: 那声巨响把我吓得魂飞魄散。

chunks.head: make one's escape
chunks.note: make one's escape = 成功逃走、脱身。
chunks.ex_en: The thief made his escape through the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷从窗户逃走了。

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在等待另一件事发生的这段时间里。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is almost ready; in the meantime, please sit down.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭快好了;在此期间,请先坐。

chunks.head: part with
chunks.note: part with = 不舍地放弃、交出(某物)。
chunks.ex_en: He hated to part with his old bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 他舍不得卖掉他的旧自行车。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: now and then (= now and again) = 不经常地、间或。
chunks.ex_en: We still meet for coffee now and then.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们偶尔还会一起喝咖啡。

chunks.head: carry on
chunks.note: carry on = 继续(做某事);carry on a business = 经营。
chunks.ex_en: Please carry on with your work.
chunks.ex_cn: 请继续你的工作。

chunks.head: look after
chunks.note: look after = 照看、负责照料某人某物。
chunks.ex_en: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
chunks.ex_cn: 这个周末你能帮我照看狗吗?

chunks.head: with all one's heart
chunks.note: with all one's heart = 真心地、十分愿意地。
chunks.ex_en: I thank you with all my heart.
chunks.ex_cn: 我衷心地感谢你。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to + 动词原形 = 表示目的。

literal.note_cn: 整体表目的,非'命令/次序'

chunks.ex_en: She left early in order to catch the bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 她提早出发,以便赶上公交车。

chunks.head: set sail
chunks.note: set sail (for …) = 启航前往某地。
chunks.ex_en: They set sail early in the morning.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们一大早就起航了。

chunks.head: presence of mind
chunks.note: presence of mind = 危急时保持冷静、迅速应对的能力。
chunks.ex_en: She had the presence of mind to call for help.
chunks.ex_cn: 她很镇定,想到了呼救。

chunks.head: hold one's breath
chunks.note: hold one's breath = 憋住气;也比喻紧张地等结果。
chunks.ex_en: Hold your breath when you dive under water.
chunks.ex_cn: 潜到水下时要屏住呼吸。

chunks.head: take to one's heels
chunks.note: take to one's heels = 撒腿逃跑。
chunks.ex_en: When the dog barked, the boys took to their heels.
chunks.ex_cn: 狗一叫,男孩们撒腿就跑。

chunks.head: with a heavy heart
chunks.note: with a heavy heart = 怀着沉重、悲伤的心情。
chunks.ex_en: With a heavy heart, she said goodbye.
chunks.ex_cn: 她心情沉重地道了别。

chunks.head: fast asleep
chunks.note: fall / be fast asleep = 熟睡(fast 此处'牢牢地、酣')。
chunks.ex_en: The baby was fast asleep by eight o'clock.
chunks.ex_cn: 宝宝八点就熟睡了。

chunks.head: make amends
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(make them amends),故 card-only。make amends (to sb) (for sth) = 弥补过错。
chunks.ex_en: He sent flowers to make amends for being late.
chunks.ex_cn: 他送花来弥补迟到的过错。

chunks.head: set free
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(set him free),故 card-only。set sb free = 放某人自由。
chunks.ex_en: They opened the cage and set the bird free.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们打开笼子,把鸟放走了。
